dz: 英语恢复:查理二世被恢复了英格兰,苏格兰和爱尔兰的王位.
de: English Restoration: Charles II is restored to the thrones of England, Scotland and Ireland.

t: 莫卧儿继承战争(1658–1659年)中争夺王位的决定性战役.
te: Decisive battle in the struggle for the throne during the Mughal war of succession (1658–1659).
dz: 萨穆加尔战役:莫卧儿继承战争(1658–1659年)中争夺王位的决定性战役.
de: Battle of Samugarh: Decisive battle in the struggle for the throne during the Mughal war of succession (1658–1659).

t: 奥斯曼帝国和萨法维帝国签署和平条约，结束 1532-1555 年的奥斯曼-萨法维战争。
te: The Ottoman Empire and the Safavid Empire sign a peace treaty to end the Ottoman–Safavid War of 1532–1555.
dz: 奥斯曼帝国和萨法维帝国签署和平条约，结束 1532-1555 年的奥斯曼-萨法维战争。
de: The Ottoman Empire and the Safavid Empire sign a peace treaty to end the Ottoman–Safavid War of 1532–1555.

t: 苏丹迈赫梅德二世手下的奥斯曼军队在经过了53天的围攻后占领了君士坦丁堡,结束了2000多年后的…
te: Ottoman armies under Sultan Mehmed II capture Constantinople after a 53-day siege, ending the Roman Empire after over 2…
dz: 君士坦丁堡陷落:苏丹迈赫梅德二世手下的奥斯曼军队在经过了53天的围攻后占领了君士坦丁堡,结束了2000多年后的罗马帝国.
de: Fall of Constantinople: Ottoman armies under Sultan Mehmed II capture Constantinople after a 53-day siege, ending the Roman Empire after over 2,000 years.

t: 皮耶特罗·洛雷丹所领导的威尼斯人击败了在加利波利外的一支更大规模的奥斯曼分舰队.
te: The Venetians under Pietro Loredan defeat a much larger Ottoman fleet off Gallipoli.
dz: 加利波利战役:皮耶特罗·洛雷丹所领导的威尼斯人击败了在加利波利外的一支更大规模的奥斯曼分舰队.
de: Battle of Gallipoli: The Venetians under Pietro Loredan defeat a much larger Ottoman fleet off Gallipoli.

t: 菲利普六世被加冕为法国国王.
te: Philip VI is crowned King of France.
dz: 菲利普六世被加冕为法国国王.
de: Philip VI is crowned King of France.

t: 蒙古人围攻开封成功后进入开封，并开始在金朝沦陷的首都进行抢劫。
te: The Mongols enter Kaifeng after a successful siege and begin looting in the fallen capital of the Jin dynasty.
dz: 蒙金战争：蒙古人围攻开封成功后进入开封，并开始在金朝沦陷的首都进行抢劫。
de: Mongol–Jin war: The Mongols enter Kaifeng after a successful siege and begin looting in the fallen capital of the Jin dynasty.

t: 伦巴第联盟击败皇帝弗雷德里克一世.
te: The Lombard League defeats Emperor Frederick I.
dz: 莱格纳诺战役:伦巴第联盟击败皇帝弗雷德里克一世.
de: Battle of Legnano: The Lombard League defeats Emperor Frederick I.

t: 一支支持教宗亚历山大三世的罗马军队被布赫的克里斯蒂安和达塞尔的拉纳尔所击败.
te: A Roman army supporting Pope Alexander III is defeated by Christian of Buch and Rainald of Dassel.
dz: 蒙特波尔齐奥战役:一支支持教宗亚历山大三世的罗马军队被布赫的克里斯蒂安和达塞尔的拉纳尔所击败.
de: Battle of Monte Porzio: A Roman army supporting Pope Alexander III is defeated by Christian of Buch and Rainald of Dassel.

t: 安提波佩·维克多四世因为克莱尔沃的伯纳德的煽动而放弃了对教宗的主张.
te: Antipope Victor IV gives up his claim to the papacy due to the instigation of Bernard of Clairvaux.
dz: 安提波佩·维克多四世因为克莱尔沃的伯纳德的煽动而放弃了对教宗的主张.
de: Antipope Victor IV gives up his claim to the papacy due to the instigation of Bernard of Clairvaux.

t: 塔米姆·伊本·优素福所指挥的阿尔莫拉维德出兵击败了由桑乔·阿尔丰塞斯亲王所指挥的一个卡斯蒂利亚…
te: Almoravid troops under the command of Tamim ibn Yusuf defeat a Castile and León alliance under the command of Prince Sa…
dz: 乌克莱斯战役:塔米姆·伊本·优素福所指挥的阿尔莫拉维德出兵击败了由桑乔·阿尔丰塞斯亲王所指挥的一个卡斯蒂利亚和莱昂同盟.
de: Battle of Uclés: Almoravid troops under the command of Tamim ibn Yusuf defeat a Castile and León alliance under the command of Prince Sancho Alfónsez.

t: 前一个月教皇史蒂芬二世去世后当选教皇保罗一世.
te: Election of pope Paul I following the death of pope Stephen II in the previous month.
dz: 前一个月教皇史蒂芬二世去世后当选教皇保罗一世.
de: Election of pope Paul I following the death of pope Stephen II in the previous month.

t: 一场灾难性的地震袭击了安提阿克,造成包括保皇党人欧普拉修斯在内的数千人死亡.
te: A catastrophic earthquake hits Antioch, killing several thousands including patriarch Euphrasius.
dz: 一场灾难性的地震袭击了安提阿克,造成包括保皇党人欧普拉修斯在内的数千人死亡.
de: A catastrophic earthquake hits Antioch, killing several thousands including patriarch Euphrasius.

t: 罗马皇帝朱利安在克特西蓬之战中击败了萨珊军队,位于萨珊首都城墙下,但无法攻克城市.
te: The Roman emperor Julian defeats the Sasanian army in the Battle of Ctesiphon, under the walls of the Sasanian capital,…
dz: 罗马皇帝朱利安在克特西蓬之战中击败了萨珊军队,位于萨珊首都城墙下,但无法攻克城市.
de: The Roman emperor Julian defeats the Sasanian army in the Battle of Ctesiphon, under the walls of the Sasanian capital, but is unable to take the city.
